title: Waymo's EMMA: Teaching Cars to Think - Jyh Jing Hwang, Waymo
talk_summary: Waymo describes EMMA, an end-to-end driving model built on Gemini that takes camera video plus text routing instructions and outputs future waypoints, then adds a chain-of-thought 'explain critical objects and meta-decisions' stage before the planner. They also discuss evaluation via open-loop replay, simulation, and generative-video sensor simulation, and show scaling data improves planner perplexity.

takeaways.what_they_do: Before emitting the final planner output, the model must first name critical objects, predict their behavior, and state a meta-decision (keep speed / yield / slow), then produce the action.
takeaways.numbers: beats strong specialized baselines (waymo/motionLM with oracle perception) on their 100k open-motion dataset

takeaways.technique: Open-loop vs simulated vs real-world eval tiers
takeaways.what_they_do: They explicitly rank evaluation fidelity: replay-based open-loop is cheap but 'not the most faithful', simulation is trusted more, real deployment is ground truth; they use each for different purposes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: open loop evaluation which means that we just replay the video ... this is usually not the most faithful way to to to do evaluation

takeaways.technique: Generative scenario simulation for edge cases
takeaways.what_they_do: They use a generative video model to synthesize controllable conditions (rain, night) to test the planner where real logs are scarce.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we can change the weather, we can change the time, we can change a lot of different ways

takeaways.technique: Task-format unification via one VLM + prompt routing
takeaways.what_they_do: Because the core is a language model, they formulate many tasks (driving, 3D detection, road graph, VQA) as prompts to one model and decode per-task, rather than maintaining separate specialized models.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the language part is super flexible we can basically formulate any types of tasks with it
takeaways.numbers: detection quality 'very similar' to state-of-the-art specialized models

takeaways.what_they_do: They translate the route/navigation signal into plain text and feed it alongside camera video, keeping the instruction channel simple and model-agnostic.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we translate it into text just pure text
